label: Avoid inefficient backtracking if final dropoff is Ketapang or Bali
recommendation: Use west-to-east route when ending in Ketapang/Bali: Surabaya → Bromo → Ijen → Ketapang.
alternatives: Add one night if adding Tumpak Sewu

label: Late airport arrival requires rest warning
recommendation: Route may be possible but guest rest time is reduced. Recommend earlier arrival or add one night when possible.

label: Waterfall before airport deadline risk
recommendation: Do not put waterfall activity before a tight airport dropoff. Skip waterfall or add one night.
alternatives: drop at hotel instead of airport

label: Ketapang ferry / Bali continuation requires pre-booking and queue buffer
recommendation: Ferizy ticket must be pre-booked H-1 (geofence-gated 2.65km from Ketapang). Allow 2–3h harbor queue buffer especially during peak / holiday periods. Confirm vehicle-crossing or guest-only handoff preference before booking.
alternatives: allow earlier departure from Ijen to hit ferry timing
use local Bali car handoff at Gilimanuk instead of vehicle crossing

label: Ijen access / quota / closure operational risk
recommendation: Ijen has a daily visitor cap (~2000/day). Ticket is required and cashless (QRIS) only since Jan 2025. Access can close without notice for volcanic activity or authority decision. Gas mask (IDR 45k rental) and medical check (IDR 20k) are mandatory on-site. Confirm ticket availability before finalizing Ijen date.
alternatives: book Ijen ticket ahead of tour date
keep alternate date flexible if quota is full
confirm eruption / access status with local guide 24h before

label: Too many destinations for available days
recommendation: Itinerary has more destination stops than the duration can support with adequate rest. Adding one or two nights significantly improves guest experience and lowers fatigue risk. Consider reducing destinations or extending tour length.
alternatives: extend by one night to allow full activity at each stop
prioritize Bromo or Ijen, not both, for very short trips

Wet season (Oct-Mar): Frequent fog, rain, and limited visibility. Cold temperatures year-round at high altitude. Rainfall — Moderate during wet season (100-200mm/month), Low during dry season (20-50mm/month) Key risk (weather, medium): Wear multiple warm layers, gloves, and beanie. JVTO provides blankets and hot drinks.
